renderings.value: The mandatory character of schooling is rarely analyzed in the multitude of works dedicated to the study of the various ways to develop within children the desire to learn.
What is most important is your strong will to master English.

These children are born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband's will, but born of God.
